title: CreateMlServingAppRequest
description: Request object for the CreateMlServingApp method.

appName.description: The name of the Cloudera AI Inference Service to be created.

clusterCrn.description: The cluster CRN of an existing cluster where Cloudera AI Inference Service instance will be deployed.

provisionK8sRequest.description: The request for Kubernetes cluster provisioning. Required in public cloud.

usePublicLoadBalancer.description: The boolean flag to request a public load balancer. By default, a private load balancer is used.

loadBalancerIPWhitelists.description: The whitelist of IPs for load balancer.

subnetsForLoadBalancers.description: The list of subnets to be used for the load balancer.

staticSubdomain.description: The static subdomain to be used for the Cloudera AI Inference Service instance.

ozoneS3Creds.description: Ozone credentials for the Cloudera On-Premise cluster.

enableFineGrainedAccessControl.description: The boolean flag to enable fine-grained access control. By default, this flag is disabled.

minInstances.description: The minimum number of instance for auto scaling.

maxInstances.description: The maximum number of instance for auto scaling.

enabled.description: The boolean flag to enable the auto scaling.

AwsCrConfig.description: The capacity reservation config for EKS

network.description: The network config having subnets for AZ

secondaryPodRangeName.description: The secondary pod range name for GCP.

InstanceGroup.description: Contains the necessary info for an instance group.

instanceType.description: The cloud provider instance type for the node instance.

instanceTier.description: The tier of the instance i.e. on-demand/spot.

instanceCount.description: The initial number of instance node.

name.description: The unique name for the instance or resource group of the workbench.

ingressRules.description: The networking rules for the ingress.

rootVolume.description: The root volume of the instance.

accelerator.description: The accelerator, which refers to the GPU type configuration.

singleZone.description: The boolean flag to provision single zone or multi zone cluster.

aws.description: The capacity reservation config for EKS.

MlServingOzoneCreds.description: Request object for the MlServingOzoneCreds method.

s3AccessID.description: The Ozone S3 access key ID name.

s3SecretAccessKey.description: The Ozone S3 secret access key name.

MlServingProvisionK8sRequest.description: Request object for provisioning Cloudera AI Inference Service instance groups.

environmentCrn.description: The CRN of the environment for the cluster to create.

tags.description: Tags to add to the cloud provider resources created. This is in addition to any tags added by Cloudera.

network.description: The overlay network for an AWS Kubernetes cluster's CNI.

Network.description: The network config for capacity reservation.

subnets.description: The array of subnets for AZ

OverlayNetwork.description: Contains the information about overlay network.

plugin.description: The plugin specifies specific cni vendor, ex: calico, weave etc.

gcp.description: The networking options for GCP platform.

ProvisionTag.description: Contains a single tag entry that will be configured on cloud resources associated with a workbench.

RootVolume.description: Configuration for instance root device volume.
